moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-spatial-orbit-context, written here): Centre button r22 ('EDIT'). Three items r15 end on a radius-62 orbit at −150, −90, −30°; each starts 130° back along the orbit and slides to its slot on a spring k150 d17, 80 ms apart from 0.55 s; icons stay upright; scale 0.6 → 1; a fading accent arc trail (2 px, gone by 2.0 s). Exit at 2.95 s (+50 ms each): continue 78° along the orbit and fade, 350 ms power2.in. Params: orbit (r62) · slots ([−150, −90, −30]°) · sweep (130°) · spring (k150 c17) · each (0.08 s).
